description: Placement mode for a TmFormActionBar: rendered in normal document flow, stuck to the top of the scroll container, or fixed to the bottom of the viewport — optionally only from the md (768px) boundary up.

members.name: StickyTop
members.description: Stick to the top of the scroll container.

members.name: FloatingBottom
members.description: Fix to the bottom of the viewport.

members.name: FloatingBottomFromMd
members.description: Responsive mode: normal document flow below the md boundary (768px), fixed to the bottom of the viewport from md up. The media query lives in the component's scoped stylesheet, and --tm-form-action-bar-reserve-block-size resolves to zero below the same boundary, so a host page that pads by the token leaves no dead space on mobile.
